activation_condition: Execute substantively only if the matched size/compression gate shows that the frozen nine z:=T re-entry candidates are admitted under macro compression but target connectivity remains false.
residual: The derived target endpoint can be re-entered under a compact search representation, but ordinary re-entry plus one congruence wrap still does not attach the target components.

rivals.R1_CONTEXTUAL_OVERLAP_BRIDGE: A proper non-root overlap between one newly admitted re-entry/congruence equality and the frozen target-narrowing frontier creates the missing component join or replayable closure.
rivals.R2_LOCAL_OVERLAP_EXISTS_BUT_INSUFFICIENT: Such overlaps exist and are lawful but none joins the target components; the missing operation is downstream of local superposition.
rivals.R3_NO_LOCAL_OVERLAP: The new and old equalities have no admissible proper non-variable overlap under the frozen representation; a different composition interface is required.

decision_rule: Use nominal cap 13 with the exact target RHS T counted as one search-state unit, retaining fully expanded terms for replay.
Add exactly the preregistered nine z:=T source-reentry substitutions and one congruence round with T as the only sibling.
Let NEW be only the graph-producing nodes added by those two stages; let OLD be only the frozen target-narrowing graph nodes from the parent search.
Enumerate proper non-variable contextual overlaps NEW→OLD and OLD→NEW with maximum context depth 4 and at most 256 candidates per direction.
Apply candidates in the frozen solver's own ranking order, checking connectivity and replay after each application.
Stop at the first replayable closure/component join; otherwise exhaust this local candidate set without expanding node, term, or overlap depth budgets.
